name: Lapki Compiler
description: Builds the state machines of the diagram with lapki-compiler: the sources and the firmware of its platform (Arduino Uno, MS-TYuK, ...). The installed compiler runs on this computer; with a remote compiler set, the diagram is sent to that server

parameters.label: Remote compiler
parameters.description: ws://host:port or host:port of a lapki-compiler server; empty - the installed compiler on this computer

parameters.label: Local compiler
parameters.description: The installed lapki-compiler: a name on PATH or a path

parameters.label: Timeout, s
parameters.description: How long to wait for the compiler; 0 - no limit

parameters.label: Output directory
parameters.description: The sources and the firmware go to its subdirectory per state machine

actions.label: Build...
actions.reason: Set the platform and its version in the diagram (e.g. ArduinoUno 1.0)
actions.description: Generate the sources of every state machine and build its firmware

actions.label: Show the code
actions.reason: Set the platform and its version in the diagram (e.g. ArduinoUno 1.0)
actions.description: Show the generated sources of every state machine in the Output tab

actions.label: Check
actions.reason: Set the platform and its version in the diagram (e.g. ArduinoUno 1.0)
actions.description: Ask the compiler whether it can build the diagram: the platform, its toolchain, the ids, the size
